open.text:
Open points

1. This reopens a design-system rule: Discussion has no votes and no accepted answer. Here Questions get both; Discussion stays on releases; on an idea the linked questions replace the Discussion panel.
2. Community tabs become What's new · Guides · Questions · Ideas.
3. Votes sort, no points or badges in v1. Role chips as in Discussion: Platform team, Champion.
4. The assistant never posts alone: its draft shows on Ask, and becomes an answer only once a person checks it (teal chip names who).
5. The Ask button in the header: when the assistant has no grounded answer, it offers 'Ask the community' with the question prefilled.
6. Admin › Community › Ideas (triage, merge, Jira link) and moderation are not drawn yet.
